approved_by: Jason 2026-10-27 (grading scale, defaults: skip early closes, no stop, MES primary)
source: Baltussen, Da, Lammers & Martens (2021), Hedging demand and market intraday momentum, JFE 142(1):377-403

data.exam: 2025-01-01..2026-10-21 locked; only via the future 3-check pass/fail proctor

rule.days: NYSE cash sessions in session-calendar.v1.csv; early-close days take no trade ($0)
rule.prior_close: close of the last bar starting before 15:00 CT on the previous NYSE session, same dated contract
rule.signal: close of the 14:29 CT bar minus prior_close; > 0 long, < 0 short, 0 no trade; missing 14:29 bar or prior close -> no trade ($0)
rule.entry: open of the 14:30 CT bar; missing -> skip ($0)
rule.exit: open of the 15:00 CT bar; missing -> non-evaluable
rule.costs: L3 once per round trip (MES 622 cents, MNQ 322); L1-L4 reported

benchmarks.primary_matched_control: same 14:30->15:00 trade with a random direction, 500 draws per day, numpy PCG64 seeded [20261026, root(MES=2,MNQ=1), yyyymmdd, 2]; daily control = mean of draws
benchmarks.deferred: random entry-time comparison (not in the first run)

inference.test: one-sided paired stationary bootstrap vs matched control, mean block 5, B=9,999, seed 20261027, null-centred, (k+1)/(B+1)
inference.alpha: workbench honesty-adjusted bar for family late_momentum (Sidak over distinct trials)
inference.sharpe_definition: mean / sd of daily L3 net over evaluable days x sqrt(252)
inference.pass_requires: p < alpha AND annual Sharpe >= 1.0 AND per_day >= 500 cents; otherwise grade = fail regardless of $/day
